Needs changes before merge.

The runtime theme keeps its process-wide lock and poison recovery. Unit tests get separate theme storage for each thread. The two new tests use ordered thread operations. No tests are removed or ignored by this change.

Local results against upstream/main `3e47b898b0148727979ff4a509f33a742f80ff1d`:

- The trial merge is clean. The PR already contains this main commit.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: all three steps passed. The build passed. The UI unit suite passed 1,055 tests. Six existing tests stayed ignored. The `theme_files` suite passed 15 tests.
- Two more parallel UI unit runs passed. Each run passed 1,055 tests, with zero failures and six existing ignored tests.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

The compiler cache did not make progress on the first gate-tool build. I stopped that command and ran all checks with the cache disabled. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/theme.rs:23` / PR body: Add before and after screenshots for the UI theme change. The review rules require this evidence for changes under `crates/ui`. The body has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the PR body. Do not add review images to this PR branch.

This change does not affect posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry. No goldens moved. Safety mutations were not required and were not run. I did not change the code.

The test results are clean. The missing screenshot evidence is the only requested change.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: The missing before and after theme screenshots are now linked in the PR body. Dark and light captures use the same 1280 × 720 seeded shell. The PNGs are stored only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Both before/after pairs are byte-identical.

Evidence pin: the PR-body check fetched all four immutable image links and verified valid PNGs. Removing a screenshot link made it fail. Restoring the link made it pass. No product code or snapshot goldens changed.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed. UI clippy passed with warnings denied. The two existing theme regression pins passed. Verification used branch-local assets after correcting a shared-target asset lookup in the initial gate run.

All four immutable links return valid 1280 × 720 PNGs from the fork's `pr-screenshots` history. The dark and light before/after pairs match. The PR branch contains no review images.

Head: `2f6e1f33892eb39f9de7742935d6d55805140bd9`. The head is unchanged because the requested evidence is already present. Plain `git push` reported that everything is up to date. No code changes were needed. The PR remains a draft.

Please re-review the screenshot evidence.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a re-review of the same head after the later evidence comments. The earlier screenshot finding is resolved.

- The PR body links all four before and after images. Each link returns a valid 1280 × 720 PNG.
- I inspected the dark and light captures. Each before/after pair is byte-identical, as expected from the unchanged runtime storage.
- The image commit belongs to the fork's `pr-screenshots` history. The PR changes no image or snapshot golden.
- Runtime storage keeps the process-wide lock and poison recovery. Unit tests use separate storage for each thread.
- Both new regression tests passed. This patch removes no tests and adds no ignored tests.

Local results from `.claude/worktrees/review-2432`, trial-merged with upstream/main `9d6b57c0983afadabc452cd3ede452bb39cea577`:

- The trial merge is clean.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all three steps.
- The UI build passed. The parallel UI unit suite passed 1,166 tests, with zero failures and seven existing ignored tests.
- The `theme_files` suite passed all 17 tests.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

The first gate command ended with signal 143 during compilation. The retry completed and passed. The checks used a separate local target directory with the compiler cache disabled. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested before merge: none. The earlier request for screenshot evidence is satisfied.

This patch does not change posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry. No goldens moved. Safety mutations were not required and were not run. I changed no code.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
